CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_thoughts(query_embedding vector, match_count integer DEFAULT 10)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, content text, source text, captured_at timestamp with time zone, embedding_model text, similarity double precision)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    thought.id,
    thought.content,
    thought.source,
    thought.captured_at,
    thought.embedding_model,
    1 - (
      thought.embedding operator(extensions.<=>) query_embedding
    ) as similarity
  from public.thoughts as thought
  order by
    thought.embedding operator(extensions.<=>) query_embedding,
    thought.id
  limit least(greatest(coalesce(match_count, 10), 1), 100);
$function$
